messages:
liam_procure: VendorX asked for 30% prepay to lock 24 H100 units for EU pool. ETA 21 days. They're holding spot for next 48h.
maria_ops: 30% prepay? that's high. do we have capacity to accept that many into staging?
kai_logistics: Depot window is tight next two weeks; we have 8 inbound slots on week 35, then limited.
ashley_finance: @liam_procure can you paste invoice line? need GL code and payment terms.
liam_procure: pasted below — short invoice from VendorX:
```
INV-4523 | VendorX
Qty 24 H100 | Unit price $12000 | Total $288k
30% prepay -> $86.4k
ETA: 21 days from PO
```
ashley_finance: ok added to queue, but prepay will need approvals. If we prepay we need a holdback clause + insurance on transit.
noah_infra: if we take all 24 we might oversubscribe eu-edge. Recommend splitting across VendorX and VendorY to reduce lead-time risk.
liam_procure: VendorY offered 40% slower ETA but no prepay. Mixed hedging buy seems sensible.
maria_ops: also consider RMA capacity — we just had a batch with a 72h turnaround. If we intake 24, RMA throughput could block deployments.
kai_logistics: can we stagger deliveries? VendorX can do two shipments (12 + 12) over 10 days. That'd smooth depot load.
liam_procure: asked them for split-shipment option, waiting for confirmation.
rma-bot: Created RMA-3245 for prior batch; est turnaround 3 days. Current open RMAs: 7
maria_ops: +1 please confirm insurance and who leads customs brokerage for split shipments.
liam_procure: VendorX will use our forwarder but requests prepay to start production. They accept letter of credit as alternative to 30% prepay.
ashley_finance: LO C might be faster to approve than straight prepay. I'll start docs today.
noah_infra: operational ask — if we stagger, please label batch A/B and pin firmware images. Last time mixes caused compatibility rework.
liam_procure: note to vendor: require serial manifest CSV + per-unit firmware baseline. also request 14-day holdback for DOA claims.
maria_ops: thanks. once vendor confirms split and manifest, we'll book depot slots and RMA window.
kai_logistics: assigning temporary holding pool at FRA DC-3, coordinate ETA runway when manifest is in.
liam_procure: will update in 2 hours. If vendor insists on single prepay only, propose 50/50 split with VendorY and escalate.
ashley_finance: tagging @finance-approvals — need expedited signoff if LO C is used.
liam_procure: thanks all. looping back with vendor now. :thumbsup:
